decisions.reason: The candidate’s requirement to retain at least the original use-based restrictions in terms for a released derivative is covered by the Section III distribution rule: when distributing the Model or Derivatives, the licensee must include the paragraph 5 use-based restrictions as enforceable provisions in agreements governing their use or distribution (line 40). This matches the candidate’s actor, derivative-distribution context, and operative duty; the preamble states the same minimum-restrictions principle for downstream derivatives released under different terms (line 15).
